intro_strings: Greenleaf, bah, r_c0 scoffs. There's nothing green about the leaves right now, so why does c_n call the dry season that?!
decline_strings: The patrol is too busy finding shelter from the sun to consider r_c0's question.

strings: It's ancient, p_l explains. Older than c_n... Maybe older than this land. No one is sure what cursed the desert to be so dry, but in other places, the sun brings light and warmth that is a relief and not a punishment. There, the dry season when the sun reaches its peak power is also the season of green leaves.

log.cats_from: cat_from enjoyed cat_to's story about how, in a distant land, the sun brings relief and growth instead of searing death.

strings: There are Clans beyond the desert, p_l explains. In high places and low, wet and, well, {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} {VERB/p_l/suppose/supposes} c_n are the cats from where it is dry. Greenleaf being the name of the dry season is older than the experience of there being a dry season. In those distant places, greenleaf is the season of plenty, not the harsh thing it is here.

log.cats_from: cat_from enjoyed cat_to's tales of distant Clans for whom greenleaf is the season of plenty.

strings: There's no time to answer r_c0's question. The patrol has been out too long, in conditions too dry and places too exposed to the scorching sun. They prioritize finding shade, but they'll need to check themselves for heatstroke when they return to camp.

condition.death_history: m_c got dehydrated training under the hot greenleaf sun, and it eventually sapped {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life from {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
